decisions.reason: As a module that builds on the firm’s established postpress offer and remained on its own webpage in both 2023 and 2024, it appears integrated into the firm’s announced automation direction and publicly committed enough that management would be inclined to continue backing it unless results clearly deteriorate.

Because this folding add-on is close to the core portfolio, is still being mentioned on the website, and is supported by a concrete customer reference showing practical use, management would likely interpret any mixed performance as temporary and keep it rather than admit a failed launch.
